entries.name: Privacy initiative (KPI)
entries.note: Community research by @WellerOlaf on optional privacy for native KAS. Not Kaspa core, not a KIP. main 98aa99fa (4 Oct 11:24:38Z), Apache-2.0, created 2 Oct, 11 commits, one author, code written with AI agents, unaudited. A0.5 on Testnet 10: a 10.2 tKAS P2SH reserve paid out once through a Groth16 BN254 proof checked by OpZkPrecompile (0xa6, Groth16 tag 0x20; KIP-16), plus introspection from KIP-10 (input/output count, amounts, output script), KIP-17 (outpoint txid/index, OpCat/OpSubstr/OpNum2Bin) and KIP-20 (OpOutputAuthorizingInput 0xd6, only to require an unbound payout). No KIP-20 covenant id (covenant=None). Release tx 29d875bb…b554 in chain block c38a5439 (3 Oct 17:56:48Z), accepted by c8dc02dd; spends 67aab5bf…:0 (1,020,000,000 sompi); fee 0.2 tKAS; BLAKE2b-256 of the 576-byte redeem equals the P2SH hash; checked on the desk's synced TN10 node 4 Oct 18:01 and 18:18 CEST. Desk build (log-based): 7/7 Rust, 28 invalid variants rejected, 13/13 Node on Node 22; draft PR #22 (A1) 20/20 Rust, unfunded, G5 open, G6 not run. Single-party trusted setup per claim. Not a privacy pool: no notes, nullifiers, private transfers or anonymity yet. His 4 Oct architecture post is design only. X backfill 6 Sep to 4 Oct: 6 to 30 Sep searched by keyword only.

entries.name: KasperoLabs: SilverScript Studio
entries.note: @KasperoLabs says SilverScript Studio is live on mainnet (25 Sep 19:18Z): write a covenant by hand, with a wizard, or by describing it to a SilverScript-only AI; deposit and withdraw with Kasware, Kasla or Kastle (Kastle deposit only, signing coming). Relay: vertex 2103759384694185988 (26 Sep 08:11Z). Source kasperolabs/silverscript-studio: MIT, created 28 Sep 21:28:34Z, tip e27a7c4e (3 Oct 22:39:10Z). The 3 Oct KasDash page (silverscriptstudio.com/kasdash.html) is a demo, not an L1 product. rusty-kaspa #1140 (kasperolabs, 30 Sep, SDK v2.1.0 findings from mainnet) open, no comments; the master keeps that line. KCC-20 gas-tank idea is an idea only (not filed on kccs). Third-party. Not desk-tested. AI contract code needs review before real KAS.
